tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog sa bcad 'khrugs can bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la don gsum/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ phyag btsal ba dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// de la bzhi/ brjod bya'i don bstan pa'i sgo nas dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu yod pa nyid du bstan pa dang*/ khengs bskyung ba dang*/ zlos skyon spangs pa'i sgo nas brjod bya khyad par can du bstan pa'o// gzhung la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung dngos so// de la bzhi/ bsnyen pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi rim pa dang*/ mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po la lnga/ dang po rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ yo byad 'byor ram dri ba dang*/ dam tshig bsrung nus sam dri ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dngos so// de la lnga/ dang po bsnyen pa'i gnas bzhi brtsam pa dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsnyen pa ma byas pa'i nyes pa dang*/ bsnyen pa'i grangs dang*/ bsnyen pa'i dgos pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa la bdun/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dang*/ thig dang*/ tshon dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ 'jug pa'o// dang po la dgu/ bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri bar gdams pa dang*/ brtag cing blos gzung ba dang*/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sa gzung ba dang*/ zhi bas bslang ba dang*/ drag pos bslang ba dang*/ sa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sa bsrung ba'o// sta gon la gnyis/ sngon du bdag bskyed pa dang*/ sta gon dngos so// de la bzhi/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ slob ma dang*/ bum pa sta gon du gnas pa'o// gnyis pa lha la bzhi/ mdun du bskyed cing ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/

mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bdag la bsdu ba'o// slob ma sta gon la gzhung na bzhi las med kyang slob ma'i gtso bo la sogs pa'o// lhag par gnas bya mchod par bya// zhes bya ba la brten nas/ lhag par gnas byas brgyad 'dzin/ de nas gzhung gi bzhi/ mchod par bya yis mchod pa/ de ltar na phyag len la bcu gsum gsungs te/ maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang*/ nang gi dbang bskur dang*/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba dang*/ spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed bya ba dang*/ bsrung ba bya ba dang*/ lhar bskyed cing mchod pa bya ba dang*/ srung skud dang*/ skyor chu dang*/ so shing dang*/ ku sha chos zab mo bshad la spro ba bskyed pa/ rmi lam brtags la ngan na bsrung ba'o// bum pa sta gon la lnga/ bsam pa rnam par dag pas bum pa la bzlas pa bya bar gdams pa dang*/ bum pa'i grangs dang*/ bcud gzhug pa dang*/ rgyan dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'o// spyi don gsum pa thig gis bri ba la bdun/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang rgyan dang lha'i rnal 'byor bstan pa dang*/ las kyi thig gi thig skud kyi rgyu dang thig chal dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang*/ ye shes kyi thig gi rgyu byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi thig ji ltar gdab pa dang*/ las thig ji ltar gdab pa dang*/ las thig gnyis rim pa ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul lo// spyi don bzhi pa tshon gyis bri ba la bzhi ste/ tshon dgye ba dang*/ lha dgod pa dang*/ zhar las byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dgram pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon chas su gzhug pa'o// dang po la drug tshon gyi rgyu dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ tshon dgye pa'i rim pa dang*/ tshon dang bzo'i las grogs dkyil 'khor dam tshig dang bslab pa sbyin pa'i tshul dang*/ rtsig pa'i tshon gyi tshad dang mtshan nyid dang*/ 'khor lo lnga la sogs pa tshon gang gis ji ltar bri bar bstan pa'o// spyi don lnga pa byin gyis brlab pa la gsum/

sngon du bskyed pa dang*/ de nas mdun du rdul tshon la bskyed pa dang*/ rdul tshon byin gyis brlab pa dngos so// mdun du bskyed pa la gsum/ sngon du sbyang ba dang*/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ go cha dang ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// rdul tshon byin gyis brlab pa la bzhi/ rang rang gi sngags gnyis su med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sgo ma bzhi dang*/ ā li dang kā lis byin gyis brlab pa'o// bar 'dir yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlab pa kha bskang*/ spyi don drug pa mchod pa la bdun/ sngags mchod sngon du song bas phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang gi dang*/ ras zung dang*/ byang sems dang*/ rjes su chags pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gis mchod pa'o// spyi don bdun pa 'jug pa la gnyis/ slob dpon chas gos dang bcas pas bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'o// de la gsum/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pas cho ga bsdus pa'i tshig dang*/ slob ma sdud pa 'jug pa dngos so// de la yol ba'i phyi rol tu slob ma rnams bos la/ slob dpon gyis las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang*/ gdong g.yogs dang*/ rdo rje me tog phreng ba rnams khyer la rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dran pas slob ma la yol ba'i phyi rol du bya ba'i cho ga ni dgu ste/ bden pa'i stobs brjod/ bla ma la 'jug pa'i yon dbul/ slob ma rnams nang du bsam/ gdong bcing*/ phreng ba gtad/ bum chus bran/ 'dod pa dri zhing lan gdab/ sems bskyed bya/ gsang bar gdams/ yol ba'i nang du gzhug ste/ de ltar yol ba'i phyi 'jug rnams gzhung na rim pa bzhin med pas kyang 'og na mar don gyis 'byung bas bar 'dir kha bskang*/ yol ba'i nang du 'jug pa la chos bcu bdun yod pa las gzhung nas bcu gnyis 'byung ste/ dbang gang 'dod ni 'di'i skabs kyi cho ga min la/ spro bskyed mi bya lhar bskyed bya ste de ltar na bcu drug nyams su blang ngo*// dam tshig bsgrags pa dang*/

bsrung ba bya/ spro ba bskyed cing lhar bskyed pa la go cha bcing ba dang*/ dbang gang 'dod pas bla ma mnyes par bya/ dpa' bo bskul/ gsol ba gdab/ phyag bya ba/ sdom pa gzung ba dang*/ dam la gzhag gsol ba gdab/ ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya/ gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// don drug pa gsol ba gdab pa la gnyis/ slob mas slob dpon la phyag bya zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa'o// bdun pa phyag la gnyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag dang*/ lus dbul ba'i phyag go /dam la gzhag pa la bzhi/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang*/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang*/ slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa'o// ye shes dbab pa la gsum/ rdzas dang*/ 'dug stangs sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sngags so// gdong dbye zhing dkyil 'khor bstan pa la gnyis/ gdong dbye zhing dkyil 'khor spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bstan pa'i sgo nas de kho na nyid brjod pa dang bcas pa'o// brtul zhugs kyi rim pa bstan pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang dngos so// dang po la gnyis/ spyir gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon du bya ba'i gsol ba gdab pa'o// dbang dngos la gsum/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ cung zad rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ cho ga rab tu rgyas par bshad pa'o// bar pa la bzhi/ dbang stegs su bzhag la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sbyang ba sngon du song bas dbang bskur bar gdams pa dang*/ sngags dang chu dbang gi tshul gyis dbang mdor bstan pa dang*/ bla ma la lus kyi nus pa med na yid kyis kyang bskul bar gdams pa'o// cho ga rab tu rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ dbang dngos dang*/ dbang de rnams kyi mjug tu bya ba mtha' rten dga' ston dang bcas pa'i yon dbul ba'o// dang po la bcu bzhi/

sngags dang*/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu'i dbang bstan pa dang*/ sngags dang ming gi dbang bstan pa dang*/ thun mong gi dang thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ bar 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gong nas btus la kha bskang ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dam tshig so so'am gcig tu bya ba lugs gnyis gang rung dang*/ lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba dang bla ma'i yon dbul ba dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes so// zhar las bzhi pa kha bskang ba'o// rjes gnang la gnyis/ rjes gnang dngos dang*/ dam tshig go /dang po la gsum/ lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bya ba dang*/ phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// sems can gyi don bya ba la bzhi/ thur ma dang*/ me long dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ dung ngo*// dam tshig la gnyis/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig bka'i gnang ba'o// mjug gi don la gnyis/ thod pa can mthong ba'i tshe smon lam dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga brtsams pa'i dge rtsa bsngo ba'o// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i bsdus pa'i don lag len gyi rim pa bzhin du dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// //gtso bo'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi sa bcad gcig kyang bgyis/ 'di ni jo bo nā ro ta pas 'khrugs bsdebs te gsungs pa bzhin du bris pa'o// 'dis gzhan la phan par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
